vb_textbox.text: I found that there was no one rule which stayed consistent throughout the game, you just have to work out which gnome between the two colours each round tends to give you more mushrooms through trial and error at first. Once you have learnt the rule, stick with it until that colour gnome starts giving you less mushrooms, and then switch to the other colour and generally that one will now be the one which leads you to more mushrooms. The person who gave me advice commented on the type of hats (pointy vs round), but I never found a pattern between them personally, only the colours. However, I feel it is important to not in case the rule changes for each participant. Good Luck!
